title: The site's web search key as an administrator reads, sets and removes it

read.$comment: given is present after a set: how many joined people's daemons answered which word. It names nobody and nothing about a person's own key beyond kept. A set whose giving could not start (the list of joined people was unavailable) answers without given: the key is stored and nobody was given it until the next set.

set.$comment: The setting administrator's own daemon makes one trial search with the key before anything is stored. A refused key answers search_key_rejected (409), a reached limit search_limit_reached (429), and a check that could not be made search_unavailable (503). Only Brave is offered until Staan's coverage has been checked. A key for one service replaces the stored key of the other, and its copies as a changed key would.
